The YSS update package auto-deployment service can use this new version %1 as an update package to automatically upgrade those older versions.

About.Title: YSS Update & Telemetry Service - About
About.Desc:
YSS Update & Telemetry Service is an auxiliary program for Yayin Story Studio, responsible for installing and updating YSS applications on your computer. In future versions, it will also provide telemetry services to help developers collect program usage and crash reports, so as to better improve YSS.

This program automatically starts when YSS is launched and runs silently in the background without user intervention. When YSS exits, this program will also exit automatically.
